article.headline: Jones has 15 in Troy's 105-60 win over LaGrange
article.description: — Randarius Jones scored 15 points as Troy beat LaGrange 105-60 on Tuesday night.
article.linkText: Jones has 15 in Troy's 105-60 win over LaGrange
article.story: TROY, Ala. -- — Randarius Jones scored 15 points as Troy beat LaGrange 105-60 on Tuesday night. Jones had six rebounds for the Trojans (7-4). Thomas Dowd scored 12 points and added six rebounds. Theo Seng shot 4 for 6, including 1 for 3 from beyond the arc to finish with 10 points. The Panthers were led in scoring by Kameron McCall, who finished with 12 points. Devin Dowell added 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
